title: 23-Layer Defect Cavity with Linear Chirp Initialization and 15 nm Adjacent Delta Constraint
scientific_hypothesis: A 23-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 defect-cavity filter initialized with monotonic linear chirp (150-300 nm) and constrained to ≤15 nm adjacent-layer thickness changes will maintain constructive interference while enabling finer spectral tuning, potentially exceeding the 0.9831 historical best score.
design_principle: Defective DBR bandpass structure (HL)^N D(LH)^N with quarter-wave mirrors and half-wave cavity, but with linearly chirped initial thicknesses to broaden the search basin. The 15 nm delta constraint prevents layer collapse while allowing smooth chirp evolution.
proposed_topology: exactly 5 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs, one cavity layer, and exactly 5 reverse-order pairs (21 finite layers)
manufacturing_considerations: adjacent-layer thickness delta ≤15 nm for deposition continuity
Ta2O5/SiO2 material pair compatible with standard sputtering
theory_basis: Defective DBR creates transmission resonance within stopband
Linear chirp initialization broadens optimization basin
Adjacent-layer continuity constraint prevents thickness collapse
expected_advantages: 23 layers provides more degrees of freedom than 21L without exceeding budget
15 nm delta constraint enforces smooth chirp evolution
Linear initialization avoids local minima from quarter-wave starting point
known_risks: May not exceed 0.9831 historical best if 21L was near-optimal
Tighter delta constraint may limit optimizer freedom
execution_request_english: Design a 23-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 defect-cavity bandpass filter on fused silica substrate for 1550 nm LiDAR application. Layer sequence: alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 starting with Ta2O5, with central Ta2O5 layer as half-wave cavity. Initialize all 23 layer thicknesses with strictly monotonic linear chirp from 150.0 nm (layer 1) to 300.0 nm (layer 23). Apply hard penalty constraint during optimization: maximum adjacent-layer thickness difference ≤15.0 nm. Optimize all 23 thicknesses to maximize transmittance at 1550 nm while minimizing transmittance in 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm bands. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with thickness bounds 50-400 nm for all layers except cavity (300-700 nm). Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 5 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs, one cavity layer, and exactly 5 reverse-order pairs (21 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1400-1500 nm, 1550-1550 nm, 1600-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance at 1550 nm (soft target ≥ 0.95); strong suppression of transmittance in 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 1400-1500 nm; transmittance in 1600-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layers ≤ 30.
revision_reason: Following insight appendage directive: changed from 21L/25L previous attempts to 23L with explicit linear chirp initialization (150-300 nm) and tightened adjacent-layer delta constraint from 40 nm to 15 nm to force perturbed chirp exploration rather than layer collapse.
